🎥🎬: Avengers: Doomsday (2026)

The Avengers face their most dangerous threat yet when Doctor Doom emerges as a powerful new enemy determined to reshape the world according to his own vision. With the fate of Earth—and potentially the entire multiverse—at stake, heroes from across the Marvel universe are forced to come together.

Old alliances are tested as powerful heroes confront an enemy whose intelligence, ambition, and technology make him unlike anything they have faced before. As Doom’s plan unfolds, the Avengers must overcome their differences and prepare for a battle that could change the Marvel Universe forever.

source_details.synopsis: Avengers: Doomsday is an upcoming American superhero film based on the Marvel Comics superhero team the Avengers. Produced by Marvel Studios and distributed by Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures, it is intended to be the sequel to Avengers: Endgame (2019) and the 39th film in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU). Directed by Anthony and Joe Russo, and written by Michael Waldron, Stephen McFeely, and the writing team of Chris McKenna and Erik Sommers, the film features an ensemble cast led by Robert Downey Jr. as Doctor Doom.
